n: ASU Unplugged Coding with Cards Card Coding Adventure
t: An unplugged card coding lesson on a floor grid for grades K-2.
steps: Find the Card Coding Adventure lesson on the ASU STEM Teachers site.
Open the slide deck and read it through.
Gather decks of cards and colored sticky notes.
Mark a grid on the floor with tape.
Try one short card sequence yourself before class.
Run the lesson with a small group first.
Try the story extension where each card is a character action.
